* '''Playtest''' ([[Twi'lek Advisor (V) (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Text: “If Audience Chamber on table, ▼ Passenger Deck or a pit. OR ▼ an alien leader or Twi'lek to Audience Chamber.”
* '''Original''' ([[Twi'lek Advisor (V)]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-twilekadvisor-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/twilekadvisor.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: “If Audience Chamber on table, ▼ Passenger Deck or a pit. OR ▼ an alien leader or Twi'lek to Audience Chamber.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics; same words.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-D-twilekadvisor.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/hires/twilekadvisor.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: “If Audience Chamber on table, ▼ Passenger Deck or a pit. OR ▼ an alien leader or a Twi'lek to Audience Chamber.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: “an alien leader or Twi'lek” became “an alien leader or a Twi'lek”; re-rendered at high resolution. '''PC transcription error:''' the words changed but the card prints no errata mark (this is errata version 1 by release order, PC-E1); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
